provider_control_identity.scope: Namespaced HST observation metadata only; no Gaia source association.

control_success_criterion: Valid QUERY_STATUS OK and TABLEDATA with exact 31-field schema, all raw cells/nulls/types/units and ascending exact objids preserved; known objid 109191367 present among 1 to 20 rows with HST/image metadata. This passes the populated scalar-query mechanics control only.
positive_but_bounded_case: Known objid present among exactly 20 valid rows passes scalar-query mechanics, while overlapping archive coverage remains truncated or unknown. No automatic pagination, all-sky completeness, original-source completeness or image-access conclusion follows.
control_failure_or_hold: One attempt. Transport/TLS/HTTP/deadline/byte-cap/ERROR/OVERFLOW/unknown serialization/schema or contradictory HST-image fields stops. Valid zero or missing known objid remains an explicit control hold. The 20-row boundary alone is a coverage limitation, not a failed mechanics control. Never repair a hold by dropping rows or changing the query.

hypothesis: A scalar ICRS point independently demonstrated to be inside a returned HST polygon should cause the fixed-point footprint query to include that known provider row.
interpretation_requirements: All returned observation identities stay provider context; no Gaia crossmatch, source photons, candidate membership or independent epoch is inferred.
Known-row inclusion tests scalar query behaviour at this metadata point, not all-sky completeness, source599 image absence or actual image WCS/pixels.
The separately reported centre being outside the literal footprint is an observed metadata relation; it does not prove catalogue error or cause the earlierHTTP500.
Any reported resolutions/pixel dimensions may be null; do not fill them from instrument expectations.
No epoch propagation, image access, product URL following or automatic remaining13 batch is included.
The numerical interior tolerance belongs to a geometry calculation, not a scientific acceptance/rejection threshold.
geometry: The documented constant POINT-in-s_region pattern, with the frozen interior literals; no column-dependent POINT and no objid filter.
rights_policy: No rights/release field exists in the saved view. This requests public metadata, not public image access.
capture_stage: Transport capture only. Even HTTP200 is NOT a validated populated fixed-point control. Actual XML QUERY_STATUS, serialization, fields/units, exact objid ordering and rows require separate inert review before interpretation.
failure_policy: One attempt; any transport/TLS/HTTP/redirect/byte/deadline failure stops. No retry, alternate endpoint, cache substitution or completed-run replay.
privacy: Raw response, all returned URLs, native headers and diagnostics remain local pending privacy review. No returned link is followed.
